seoDescription: Enhance your WooCommerce store by transforming default product variation dropdowns into visually appealing and user-friendly swatches. This guide details how to use a free plugin by CartFlows to create clickable color swatches, text-based label buttons for sizes, and even image swatches for patterns or textures. Learn to configure global product attributes for site-wide consistency, customize the shape and size of your swatches, and optimize the shopping experience on both product and archive pages for better conversion.

chapters.title: Introduction & Plugin Installation
chapters.description: This chapter introduces the visual upgrade for WooCommerce variations and guides you through installing the free Variation Swatches plugin by CartFlows.

chapters.title: Out-of-the-Box Functionality
chapters.description: Explore the immediate effects of the plugin, which automatically converts dropdowns to labels, and see how to edit swatches for existing product-specific attributes.

chapters.title: Creating Global 'Size' Attribute
chapters.description: Learn the recommended method of creating a global 'Size' attribute with a 'Label' type that can be reused across all products.

chapters.title: Creating Global 'Color' Attribute
chapters.description: This chapter shows how to create a global 'Color' attribute, configure it to display as circles, and add various color terms with their hex values.

chapters.title: Creating Global 'Image' Attribute
chapters.description: Set up a global 'Pattern' attribute that uses images for its swatches, such as for textures or unique designs.

chapters.title: Applying Global Attributes to a Product
chapters.description: This chapter covers removing old custom attributes from a product and applying the new global 'Size', 'Color', and 'Pattern' attributes.

chapters.title: Linking Variations to Images
chapters.description: Complete the setup by manually linking each unique variation combination to its corresponding product image for a dynamic user experience.

chapters.title: Customizing Swatch Appearance Globally
chapters.description: Discover how to edit global attributes to change the appearance of swatches site-wide, such as modifying their shape and size.

chapters.title: Setting Default Variations
chapters.description: Improve the user experience by pre-selecting a default variation so customers see a complete product and price upon loading the page.

chapters.title: Exploring General Plugin Settings
chapters.description: Dive into the main settings panel for the Variation Swatches plugin to configure global styling, tooltips, out-of-stock behavior, and more.

chapters.title: Shop Page Styling and Conclusion
chapters.description: Fine-tune the appearance of swatches on the shop/archive page, including alignment and attribute limits, and see the final result.

summary:
## Key Concepts: WooCommerce Variation Swatches

This document outlines how to replace standard WooCommerce dropdown menus for variable products with enhanced visual swatches for colors, sizes, and images using a free plugin.

### Recommended Plugin

- **Name**: WooCommerce Variation Swatches
- **Author**: **CartFlows**
- **Benefit**: Provides premium features in a free version, offering excellent value.

### Global vs. Per-Product Attributes

The most efficient way to manage swatches is by creating global attributes that can be used across multiple products, ensuring consistency and saving time.

> [!TIP]
> Always create attributes under **Products > Attributes** for reusability. Avoid creating custom attributes on a per-product basis unless it's a one-off item.

### Swatch Attribute Types

The plugin adds a "Type" field when creating or editing attributes, allowing you to choose how the swatch is displayed.

- **Label**: Displays the attribute term as text in a clickable button. Ideal for **sizes** (e.g., S, M, L).
- **Color**: Displays a solid color swatch. You can select the exact color and the shape (circle, square, rounded).
- **Image**: Displays a small thumbnail image. Perfect for **patterns**, **textures**, or material finishes.

### Configuration Workflow

1.  **Install the Plugin**: Search for "WooCommerce Swatches" by **CartFlows** and activate it.
2.  **Create Global Attributes**: Navigate to **Products > Attributes**.
    -   Create a `Size` attribute with **Type: Label**.
    -   Create a `Color` attribute with **Type: Color**.
    -   Create a `Pattern` attribute with **Type: Image**.
3.  **Configure Terms**: For each attribute, add and configure its terms (e.g., add "Red," "Blue," etc., to the Color attribute and pick their colors).
4.  **Apply to Product**: Edit a variable product, go to the **Attributes** tab, select your new global attributes, and choose the specific terms available for that product (e.g., only Red and Purple for a shirt).
5.  **Generate Variations**: Go to the **Variations** tab and click "Create variations from all attributes."
6.  **Link Images & Prices**: Manually assign the correct product image and price to each generated variation.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> You must expand each variation and link it to the corresponding image. If you skip this step, the product image will not change when a user selects a swatch.

### Key Plugin Settings

Navigate to **WooCommerce > Variation Swatches** to customize behavior:

-   **Auto Convert Dropdowns**: Automatically converts all existing dropdowns to the new swatch style.
-   **Global Styling**: Set default swatch size, shape (border-radius), and border colors.
-   **Shop Page Styling**: Control swatch alignment (e.g., `center`), position (e.g., before or after the price), and limit the number of swatches shown on the archive page.
-   **Out of Stock Behavior**: Choose how to display unavailable options: **Blur**, **Blur with Cross**, or **Hide**.
